QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.scan.eq_1 (artifact : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact)
  (order : List Nat) (state : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.State) :
  QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.scan artifact order state =
    List.foldlM (QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.step artifact) state order
QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedScan.eq_1 (artifact : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact)
  (context : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (order : List Nat)
  (state : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.State) :
  QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedScan artifact context order state =
    List.foldlM (QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedStep artifact context) state order
QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedLocalCheck.congr_simp
  (artifact artifact✝ : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact) (e_artifact : artifact = artifact✝)
  (context : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (index index✝ : Nat)
  (e_index : index = index✝) (remaining remaining✝ : Nat) (e_remaining : remaining = remaining✝) :
  QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedLocalCheck artifact context index remaining =
    QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedLocalCheck artifact✝ ⋯ index✝ remaining✝
QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedStep.congr_simp
  (artifact artifact✝ : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact) (e_artifact : artifact = artifact✝)
  (context : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact)
  (state state✝ : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.State) (e_state : state = state✝) (index index✝ : Nat)
  (e_index : index = index✝) :
  QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedStep artifact context state index =
    QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedStep artifact✝ ⋯ state✝ index✝
